plan.name: Search and Confirm Coolness
plan.strategy: Locate the apple first, then confirm its coolness before disposal.
steps: Check the fridge 1 for an apple.
If found, confirm if the apple is cool. If not, place it in the fridge 1 to cool.
Once the apple is cool, take it and move to the garbagecan 1.
Place the cool apple in the garbagecan 1.
